data.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
data.descriptionHtml:
The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is a premium flagship smartphone built for exceptional performance, professional photography, productivity, and an immersive viewing experience. Powered by the Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy processor and equipped with up to 16GB of RAM, it delivers fast and reliable performance for demanding apps, gaming, multitasking, and AI-powered features.

 

Key Features

 

- 6.9" Dynamic AMOLED 2X Display with QHD+ resolution, adaptive 120Hz refresh rate, and up to 2600 nits peak brightness.

- Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy processor built on a 3nm architecture, with speeds up to 4.74GHz.

- Professional Quad Camera System featuring a 200MP main camera, 50MP ultra-wide, 50MP 5x telephoto, and 10MP 3x telephoto camera.

- Up to 100x Digital Zoom with OIS, Laser AF, Scene Optimizer, and advanced image processing.

- 12MP Front Camera for high-quality selfies and video calls.

- 5,000mAh Battery with up to 31 hours of video playback and Wireless PowerShare.

- Built-in S Pen for precise writing, drawing, note-taking, and productivity.

- Advanced Connectivity including 5G, Dual SIM, USB Type-C, Wi-Fi Direct, and UWB.

- Ultrasonic Fingerprint Sensor for fast and secure authentication.

- Long-Term Software Support with security updates available until February 2033.

- Unlocked for flexible carrier compatibility.

 

Specifications

 

Processor: Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy (3nm)

RAM: 12GB / 16GB

Storage: 256GB / 1TB

Display: 6.9" Dynamic AMOLED 2X, QHD+, 120Hz

Peak Brightness: Up to 2600 nits

Main Camera: 200MP

Ultra-Wide: 50MP

Telephoto: 50MP 5x + 10MP 3x

Front Camera: 12MP

Battery: 5,000mAh

Operating System: Android

SIM: Dual SIM

Connectivity: 5G, 4G LTE, USB Type-C, Wi-Fi Direct, UWB

S Pen: Supported

Security: Ultrasonic Fingerprint Sensor

Carrier: Unlocked

 

Overview

 

The Galaxy S26 Ultra combines flagship performance, advanced camera technology, a high-resolution 120Hz display, S Pen functionality, and long-term software support in a premium smartphone designed for demanding users.

data.title: Anker Soundcore Liberty 4 NC — White
data.descriptionHtml:
Anker Soundcore Liberty 4 NC — White delivers advanced active noise cancellation, detailed wireless audio, and long battery life in a compact true-wireless design. It is a strong choice for everyday listening, commuting, calls, and travel.

Adaptive Noise Cancellation

Adaptive ANC 2.0 analyzes your ears and surrounding environment in real time to adjust noise cancellation automatically. Soundcore states that the Liberty 4 NC system can reduce external noise by up to 98.5% under its test conditions.

Hi-Res Wireless Sound

Custom-tuned 11mm drivers are designed for clear, detailed playback. The earbuds support Hi-Res Wireless audio and LDAC on compatible devices, while HearID 2.0 and adjustable EQ options in the Soundcore app let you personalize the sound profile.

Battery and Connectivity

  • Up to 10 hours of playback from the earbuds and up to 50 hours with the charging case in normal listening conditions
  • Fast charging: around 10 minutes of charging can provide up to 4 hours of playback
  • Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint connection for switching between compatible devices
  • Wireless charging support for the case

Calls and Everyday Use

Six microphones work with an AI algorithm to improve voice clarity during calls. IPX4 water resistance provides protection against splashes and light rain, while automatic play/pause and quick Android pairing add everyday convenience.

Key Features

  • Adaptive ANC 2.0
  • 11mm custom-tuned drivers
  • Hi-Res Wireless and LDAC support
  • HearID 2.0 and customizable EQ
  • Bluetooth 5.3 multipoint
  • 6 microphones with AI call processing
  • IPX4 water resistance
  • White finish
